status: Hardware gate queued; successor Agent implementation not yet validated
hypothesis: Use a completed speculative tool result to start the next full Actor while the current full Actor is still running; adopt only when the next serialized input and environment match exactly.
baseline: Original full-reasoning SPORK, with the same model, sampling settings, tool environment and D1/D2/D3 settings.

inherited_ideas.Speculative Actions: Multi-step speculation and rejecting invalid descendants
inherited_ideas.Controlled Token-Efficient Speculation: Retain compatible descendant work and account for wrong-branch cost
inherited_ideas.ObsSpec: Overlap policy inference with an anticipated observation, but this prototype would use an actual isolated speculative tool result instead of predicting the observation
inherited_ideas.SPORK: Early tool prediction/execution and shared-prefix serving

online_inputs: Committed conversation and current visible Actor prefix
The already predicted parent call and its actual isolated tool result
Tool environment fingerprints and exact next-prompt token IDs
output: A future containing the next full Actor decision and optionally its isolated tool execution; it is never committed before the parent is validated.
training_labels: None. Full Actor trajectories are evaluated only after the run; they are not admission inputs.
proposed_contract: Keep the parent Actor reasoning until its normal completion.
Every child starts from a separate copy of the environment AFTER the speculative parent tool. Never let child mutations enter the parent environment.
Require exact parent name/arguments, observation, post-parent state, generation settings, and full rendered next-prompt token IDs before reuse.
Cancel and drain rejected child work, including actual tool threads, before moving on; include this cost.
Initially use fixed disjoint pairs (turns 1/2, 3/4), one child at most, and no recursive descendants.
Disable D3 registration/clear inside an uncommitted child because the current sidecar clear is server-wide; retain ordinary target generation and tool speculation.
Record wasted tokens and resources, not just accepted branches.
admission_controls: Prefetch as soon as the predicted tool result is available
Optional causal admission using one unforced confirmation from the then-visible parent prefix, to avoid spending a full successor on an already stale candidate
known_implementation_points: Tau2ToolExecutor.execute_speculative can expose a result-ready callback without changing Actor decisions.
The callback must copy the post-parent environment before starting any child tool execution.
The candidate assistant serialization used in the retrospective bound was <tool_call> plus canonical JSON plus newline; actual whole-prompt token comparison remains mandatory.
D3 status active_requests counts registered draft states, not all running inference requests. Use process ownership and shared port locks to prevent experiment overlap.
Batch-invariant requested is not proof of token equivalence. Check empirical full Actor outputs under concurrency before any preservation claim.

hardware_preflight.groups: smallest eligible training ID per airline/retail domain
hardware_preflight.inputs: saved complete prompts without saved thinking prefixes
hardware_preflight.limitations: Second prompt includes a recorded later observation; this only tests hardware concurrency and greedy token equivalence, not causal online speedup.

next_gate: If parallel pair makespan does not improve or tokens differ, inspect that evidence before building a full successor runner. If useful, implement the contract and test both a correct-candidate case and a stale-candidate rejection case with all failures retained.
